process.title: A Transparent, 4-Step Engineering Process
process.subtitle: No surprises, no missed deadlines. Here is exactly how we take your project from initial idea to production launch.

steps.title: Discovery & Scope Definition
steps.desc: We start with a thorough review of your business goals, target audience, and feature requirements. Within 24 hours, you receive a transparent fixed-price proposal with milestone deliverables.

steps.title: UI/UX & Architecture Blueprint
steps.desc: Before writing code, we establish the design system, interactive wireframes, and database models to ensure the user flow is frictionless and scalable.

steps.title: Agile Build & Staging Demos
steps.desc: The application is engineered using clean, modular MERN code. You receive live staging preview links at each major milestone to provide real-time feedback.

steps.title: Deployment, Handover & 7-Day Guarantee
steps.desc: We handle DNS setup, SSL certificates, database indexing, and production deployment. You receive full source code repository ownership and a 7-day guarantee to fix technical issues after delivery, within the originally agreed project scope.

faqs.q: How do payments and milestones work?
faqs.a: Projects are typically structured with a 50% deposit to initiate scoping and architecture, and 50% upon final sign-off and deployment to production. For larger full-stack apps, milestone payments can be divided into 3 phases.

faqs.q: Do I own 100% of the source code?
faqs.a: Yes, absolutely! Upon final project completion, you receive complete ownership and full access to the GitHub repository, database schemas, and documentation. No licensing lock-ins.

faqs.q: What if I need ongoing maintenance or new features later?
faqs.a: Every project includes a 7-day guarantee to fix technical issues after delivery, within the originally agreed project scope. This does not cover new feature requests, design changes, or any additions outside the original scope, which are billed as separate new work.

faqs.q: Why choose a freelance MERN engineer instead of an agency?
faqs.a: With me, you communicate directly with the engineer actually building your product. There are no junior developers, no account manager games, lower overhead costs, and much faster iteration cycles.
